rationale: LMT has gapped up ~5% on no news, is trading at the absolute top of today's range (position 100%), and the last 1-minute candle shows a massive volume spike (116k shares) driving price from ~$580 to ~$593 — a classic exhaustion/climax bar that makes both long and short entries extremely risky at this moment. With SPY down and VIXY elevated, the broad tape is risk-off, but chasing a gap-and-spike into new highs without a news catalyst or any consolidation pattern to anchor a stop is speculative. The spread is wide relative to the ATR, and the risk/reward for either direction is unclear until price settles and forms a readable structure.
